title: Edmonton police cleared in 2006 death
article: A judge has cleared Edmonton police of wrongdoing in the death of a man who died five days after a violent takedown.
The fatality inquiry report by provincial court Judge Lloyd Malin says Mark Milakovic, 25, died on July 13, 2006, from medical complications of a heart attack and illegal drug use.
Police struggled to arrest Milakovic after he carjacked a vehicle, hitting him in the head numerous times.
The report says when officers finally got him out of the car and on the ground he stopped breathing, suffering a heart attack.
A toxicology report found cocaine, animal tranquilizer and marijuana in his system and one of his arteries was 90 per cent blocked.
The report recommends that police should be taught how to clear airway passages when performing CPR.
A judge in a fatality inquiry provides a written report and may make recommendations for prevention of similar incidents. But the inquiry does not include any findings of legal responsibility.
